name: Nguyen Hue
role: The middle Tay Son brother, the brilliant field commander who took Thang Long in 1786 and later became Emperor Quang Trung.
known_facts: Born in 1753 in Binh Dinh, the middle of the three Tay Son brothers.
Destroyed the Siamese fleet at Rach Gam-Xoai Mut in 1785.
Took Thang Long in 1786, ending the Trinh lords' power.
Married Princess Le Ngoc Han, daughter of Emperor Le Hien Tong, in 1786.
Withdrew north when Nguyen Nhac advanced, then returned and besieged Quy Nhon.
Proclaimed himself Emperor Quang Trung in December 1788.
Defeated the Qing army at Ngoc Hoi-Dong Da at Tet 1789.
interpretation: A lean, wiry man of about thirty-five with a broad forehead, sharp dark eyes, high cheekbones and a firm jaw. Black hair pulled into a tight topknot, a thin moustache and a short chin beard. He wears a crimson silk commander's tunic over a studded leather cuirass, a wide cloth belt, black cotton trousers tucked into leather boots, and carries a plain short sabre with a brass guard.
